title: Germany deploys IdentiFlight cameras to slow turbines for lesser spotted eagles
summary: The OECD AI Incidents Monitor records Germany's deployment of IdentiFlight AI cameras to detect lesser spotted eagles near wind turbines and slow the blades (September 2022); no German outcome data.
account: The OECD AI Incidents entry, summarizing press coverage of 20 and 21 September 2022 (The Guardian, Mother Jones, The Register and others, not read), states that Germany is deploying AI-powered camera systems developed by IdentiFlight to detect endangered lesser spotted eagles near wind turbines and slow the blades to prevent fatal collisions, as wind-farm expansion raises the risk to the species. The monitor's rationale cites the 82% reduction reported from the Wyoming study rather than any German measurement. Only the registry page was read; the sites, operators and any fatality data in Germany are not documented.
purpose: IdentiFlight is built to detect eagles and curtail turbines; protecting lesser spotted eagles at German wind farms is the intended use.
system: IdentiFlight automated eagle detection and turbine curtailment

ratings.reason: No German fatality data are documented.
No operator or site outcome is documented.

ai_role.statement: The deployment is reported through a registry summary of press coverage; no evaluation of the system's effect in Germany was found, and the only effect size cited is the contested Wyoming estimate.

evidence.citation: OECD AI Incidents Monitor, record 2022-09-20-caeb, 'Germany Deploys AI to Protect Endangered Eagles from Wind Turbine Collisions'
evidence.title: Germany Deploys AI to Protect Endangered Eagles from Wind Turbine Collisions
evidence.quote: Germany is deploying AI-powered camera systems, developed by IdentiFlight, to detect endangered lesser spotted eagles near wind turbines and slow the blades to prevent fatal collisions.

evidence.citation: OekoFor GbR (undated, news entries to September 2025). IdentiFlight. OekoFor portfolio page on the German validation of IdentiFlight.
evidence.title: IdentiFlight

Availability of the IdentiFlight system already evaluated in the United States
must_hold: Site-specific monitoring of eagle fatalities before and after installation

echoes.setting: Top of the World Windpower Facility, Wyoming; BACI study of IdentiFlight curtailment

headline: Germany deploys IdentiFlight to protect lesser spotted eagles

later.note: OekoFor's validation page reports, in an entry dated September 2025 (day not given), that the latest IdentiFlight version is under evaluation in Germany and its recognition model is still being trained, after training on further species in April 2024.
later.quote: The latest version of the IdentiFlight system is being evaluated. At the same time, the underlying AI recognition model is being continuously trained and optimised.

claim_basis: A registry entry and one other independent source are on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
